title: hf test zero-test failures include actionable runner/filter diagnostics
objective: The Weave /review run correctly failed closed when several `cargo test` filters executed zero tests, but the recovery required manual test-name/feature investigation. The fail-closed behavior is correct and must remain; upgrade the diagnostics so a zero-test result gives actionable next steps, especially for Cargo filters hidden behind features. For Cargo, suggest `cargo test -p <pkg> --features <needed> -- --list` or show nearby matching test names when practical. This is a fleet UX hardening task, not a weakening of the completion gate.
acceptance_criteria: `hf test` still fails closed when a recognized runner executes zero tests.
For Cargo zero-test results, output includes the package/filter that matched zero and an actionable suggestion to run `cargo test ... -- --list`, preserving any required feature flags when known.
Where feasible, hf captures/list-checks nearby test names or at least distinguishes 'compiled without feature-gated tests' from 'filter typo' using Cargo list output.
Tests cover a zero-test Cargo command and assert the diagnostic contains the suggested list command and does not mark the task done.
No downgrade to HFTASK-0045/HFTASK-0063 evidence gating.
